title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Digital Twin - CMR
description: The CMR consignment note ('carta de porte'), a document used for the regulation of road freight transport and adopted by most European states as an international agreement regulating legal issues in road freight transportation (simple-dt:CMR, SIMPLE extension to the FEDeRATED DigitalTwin ontology, subclass of Document).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CMR'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. DigitalTwin:name (inherited from LogisticsObject). Human-readable label for this document.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

UUID.description: Property. DigitalTwin:UUID (inherited from LogisticsObject). Unique identifier of this document as a logistics object, distinct from the NGSI-LD entity id.

country.description: Property. DigitalTwin:country (inherited from LogisticsObject). Country associated with this document (e.g. country of issuance).

documentID.description: Property. DigitalTwin:documentID (inherited from Document). Identifier of this CMR document.

documentVersion.description: Property. DigitalTwin:documentVersion (inherited from Document). Version of this CMR document.

hasDocumentType.description: Property. DigitalTwin:hasDocumentType (inherited from Document). The type of this document.

hasMRN_Number.description: Property. DigitalTwin:hasMRN_Number (inherited from Document). Movement Reference Number associated with this document.

hasExternalIdentifier.description: Relationship. DigitalTwin:hasExternalIdentifier (inherited from LogisticsObject). External identifier(s) of this document in other systems. Range: DigitalTwin:ExternalIdentifier (out of scope of this candidate).
